name: Witching-Reach
specific_features: Navigation instruments malfunction in specific zones
description: Witching-Reach is a cold, rust-colored rocky world where labyrinthine canyon systems cut through iron oxide plains in patterns that seem almost deliberately confusing. The thin atmosphere supports a haze of fine dust that turns the sky a perpetual deep crimson, even at local noon.

The magnetic anomaly zones that dot the surface create pockets where compasses spin and electronic navigation fails entirely. Explorers describe an unsettling sense of disorientation in these zones, as if the planet itself is deliberately misdirecting them through its stone corridors.

Microbial life clings to existence in the canyon depths, where thin deposits of subsurface ice provide just enough moisture. These organisms have developed magnetotactic properties, aligning themselves with the anomalous magnetic fields in ways that suggest they may be contributing to the navigational disruptions.

Uranium deposits in the deeper canyon systems make Witching-Reach commercially interesting despite its navigational hazards. Several automated prospecting drones have been lost in the anomaly zones, their final telemetry showing them traveling in perfect circles before signal loss.
